versions.content: DcmDspEcuResetRow container configuration One container DcmDspEcuResetRow shall be configured for each DcmDsdSubService ( DcmDspEcuResetId matching to the DcmDsdSubServiceId ) configured for the UDS service ECUReset (0x11) which does not have the corresponding DcmDsdSub- ServiceFnc parameter configured.
